source.note: Full download of the AMUPedia website (amupedia.netlify.app, a student-run AMU site) and the Google Drive folders it links to, done 2026-11-15. Credit AMUPedia. B.Tech/First Year/<Subject> are the first-year common courses (Notes/Unit N, 'Part N' prefixes are the site's order). B.Tech/<Branch>/2nd Year/<Semester>/<Subject> mirror each branch's Drive folder; course codes in folder names (CEC2130 etc.) are AMU ZHCET codes. 'ECE AI/Sem 1' is a first-semester folder (Analog Electronics, Basic Electrical, Programming in C); check from the files whether it is AMU material. 'Books' folders hold published textbooks: not ours to publish. 'Fluid mechanics nptel lectures' are NPTEL videos (not AMU's own). Files named _UNAVAILABLE.txt, _MISSING.txt, _BROKEN.txt, _FOLDER_LINK.txt are download notes, not material; video-links.txt files list YouTube lectures. Part of the Mechanical 2nd-year and AI semester-3 material was already merged from AMUPedia's Drive on 2026-11-07.
